title: Comfort Club Late-Fee Standing and the Replacement System Installations Member Install Credit
content:
# Standing multiplier on the member install credit

## Rule

The standing factor of the member install credit on a Replacement System Installations contract counts the late fees charged on the homeowner's Comfort Club agreement in the 12 months before the date of handling:

- with two or more such late fees, the credit is multiplied by 0.7;
- with exactly one, by 0.85;
- with none, by 1.0.

The late fees are the late-fee entries on the agreement's billing history in the Comfort Club Maintenance Agreements records.

## Cases (hypothetical billing histories)

| Late fees charged in the 12 months before the date of handling | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| 0 | 1.0 |
| 1 | 0.85 |
| 2 | 0.7 |
| 3 | 0.7 |

- One late fee 5 months ago and another 14 months ago: only one falls in the 12 months — 0.85.
- Late fees 2 and 9 months ago: two in the window — 0.7.
- No late fee in the last 12 months: 1.0.
